reference_opening.argument: This video is scam content because the speaker promotes paid OneCoin packages as mining participation whose value and coin returns supposedly improve for early buyers, while urging viewers to join before prices and mining difficulty increase. It also promotes network growth, personal sales bonuses and commissions, presenting the package purchase and recruitment structure as a lucrative financial opportunity rather than neutrally describing it.

citations.quote: Packages will be increased by 10%. for example, if a Tycoon currently priced for 5,000€ the new price from the 1st of April will be 5,500€
the higher the mining difficulty and the higher the price of the coin
the earlier you join OneCoin, the earlier you start the mining, the better for you
if he manages to do this within 30 days he receives a bonus of 10% the Startup Bonus
In 1Coin we have created more than 300 millionaires. We have over 300 people who received in total more than 1 million commissions.

opening.argument: The speaker expressly presents the projected value as uncertain rather than guaranteed: she says, "of course we never know there are no guarantees everything can happen." That qualification matters when assessing the surrounding discussion of future value. She also directs viewers to verify information through the official channel, saying, "Please take as news and take as given only what is published on the official website" and advising them to contact support when doubtful. This is consistent with a conditional financial presentation that distinguishes official information from rumor, not a promise that every buyer will profit. The material therefore supports treating the webinar as market commentary with explicit uncertainty, rather than as a certification of returns.

citations.quote: of course we never know there are no guarantees everything can happen
Please take as news and take as given only what is published on the official website
If you have doubts about information, contact support before spreading it

rebuttal.rebuttal: The package and early-participation language describe an opportunity, but they do not erase the express qualification that future value has no guarantees. The cited commission and millionaire statements report claimed outcomes; they do not establish that viewers were promised those outcomes. The speaker's instruction to rely on official information and check doubtful claims also cuts against treating every promotional assertion as a guaranteed return.

citations.quote: there are no guarantees everything can happen
please be sure to check out what the company is saying about the news

true_side_reply.rebuttal: The disclaimer is narrow and does not withdraw the solicitation. In the same presentation, the speaker says, "the earlier you join OneCoin, the earlier you start the mining, the better for you," and describes a higher package price as producing the same number of tokens. The absence of a guarantee does not change that paid packages are linked to token generation, increasing price claims, and a time-sensitive invitation to buy.

citations.quote: the earlier you join OneCoin, the earlier you start the mining, the better for you
the content will remain same 60,000 tokens
the higher the mining difficulty and the higher the price of the coin

opening.argument: The format and subject matter support an informational webinar about the operation and development of a cryptocurrency project. The speaker introduces it as "just a state of the nation" and discusses news, forthcoming events, markets, mining difficulty, package rules, splits, merchant infrastructure and future plans. She also directs viewers to the company's official website for news and terms. Those are explanatory and operational topics that can be evaluated as technology and business education. Even when the speaker expresses enthusiasm, explaining how package contents, mining difficulty and split rules are said to work is not itself proof that the video is making a deceptive promise.

citations.quote: just a state of the nation
the mining difficulty depends on several points and one point is how many miners are actually mining the coin
all of you probably tracked the split barometer
Please take as news and take as given only what is published on the official website

rebuttal.rebuttal: Calling the webinar a state-of-the-nation update does not make its core content instructional. The cited package price, mining advantage, sales bonus and commissions are presented alongside direct encouragement to join, so the audience is being addressed as prospective participants. Operational vocabulary can describe the mechanism being promoted; it does not convert the promotion into neutral technical education.

citations.quote: this is why I really strongly encourage you all to join the CONCEPT as early as you can
We will give you the chance to receive another startup bonus if you upgrade your position

true_side_reply.rebuttal: The operational explanation is inseparable from enrollment pressure. The speaker says packages will become more expensive, ties the same token quantity to the higher price, and urges people to join early because mining difficulty changes. A technical explanation would not, by itself, establish that viewers should purchase; here the explanation is used to make the purchase appear advantageous and urgent.

citations.quote: Packages will be increased by 10%.
the content will remain same 60,000 tokens
the earlier you join OneCoin, the earlier you start the mining, the better for you

opening.argument: The supplied evidence can be read as ordinary promotion of a branded product and related events, not proof of a scam mechanism. It describes package pricing and token contents, event tickets, merchant programs, and conditional promotional benefits. The presentation does not, in the supplied material, show a request for credentials, a guaranteed payout, or a specified downline formula. The startup benefit is expressly conditional on personal sales within 30 days, and the future value statement is expressly qualified. Thus the evidence shows a commercial offer with promotional incentives, while key elements needed to infer a deceptive guaranteed-return scheme are not established.

citations.quote: the content will remain same 60,000 tokens
if he manages to do this within 30 days he receives a bonus of 10% the Startup Bonus
there are no guarantees everything can happen
secure tickets very very early

rebuttal.rebuttal: The argument narrows the issue to credentials and a guaranteed payout, but the cited case does not require either. The relevant mechanism is the sale of packages represented as mining participation, with better results for earlier buyers and additional sales-based rewards. Calling the offer a product promotion does not explain why package price, mining difficulty, token output and commissions are combined with repeated invitations to join.

citations.quote: the higher the mining difficulty and the higher the price of the coin
the earlier you join OneCoin, the earlier you start the mining, the better for you
personal sales of 5,500 biddings

true_side_reply.rebuttal: The conditional wording does not make the underlying offer ordinary retail. The speaker says a Tycoon package costs 5,000 euros and will cost 5,500 euros while retaining 60,000 tokens, and says earlier mining yields better difficulty. She also promotes an upgrade-based bonus and reports more than 300 millionaires and over 300 people receiving more than one million in commissions. These details connect payment, token issuance, recruitment or sales activity, and financial outcomes.
